dog.description_text:
Meet sweet Hershey! This young boy came into our care very underweight and will need some extra TLC as he works toward becoming a happy, healthy pup. His new family will need to follow a strict refeeding schedule and be committed to giving him the care and consistency he needs.

While we don't know much about Hershey's past, we're looking forward to getting to know him and watching his personality blossom as he gains strength and confidence. He deserves a patient, loving home that will give him the time, care, and support he needs to thrive.

Hershey may have had a difficult start, but we're hopeful his brightest days are still ahead. Sweet Hershey is ready for a fresh start and someone to call his own!
dog.name: Hershey
